name: Volunteer Services
what_you_do: Volunteer at AdventHealth hospitals. Work in nursing units, guest services, the pharmacy, imaging or the gift shop, and more. It is good for school service hours and a look at health care.
who_can_apply: Anyone 16 or older. At least four hours a week. Some sites are full; check the list on the page.
duration: At least 4 hours a week, flexible
deadline_text: Last read Oct 10, 2026, when most sites were taking new volunteers. Altamonte Springs, Apopka, East Orlando and Orlando were on that list. Call to confirm.
how_to_apply: Step 1: online volunteer orientation. Step 2: online application. Step 3: contact them to set up an interview. Call 407-543-4047.
notes: As of Nov 4, 2026, the AdventHealth site blocked automated reading, so confirm these details first. Pick a site that is taking applications. The internships on the same page are for college students, not high school.
